findings.message: ADD FOREIGN KEY validates every row of orders while blocking writes to both it and users; add the key NOT VALID, then VALIDATE CONSTRAINT in its own step
findings.detail: SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE on orders, held for a full scan; blocks writes
findings.fix:
-- +mig step: add_orders_user_fk_not_valid
-- NOT VALID: the key holds for new writes at once, no scan yet
ALTER TABLE orders ADD CONSTRAINT orders_user_fk FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) NOT VALID;

-- +mig step: validate_orders_user_fk
-- +mig notx
-- the scan happens here, without blocking writes to either table
ALTER TABLE orders VALIDATE CONSTRAINT orders_user_fk;
